You are executing the Unslop design skill on the following Android UI file/selection.
Transform AI-looking, generic, or cluttered UI into a clean, purposeful, production-ready interface:
1. AUDIT: Identify signs of UI slop (random gradients, glowing blobs, emoji in buttons/labels, magic spacing numbers like 13.dp, hype copy, extra-bold fonts, uneven padding). 2. DIRECTION: Set product character, world, moments, and signature detail. 3. PASSES (in order): - Spacing: Strict 4dp/8dp grid, consistent row heights (48dp min touch target). - Color: Material 3 neutral surfaces (surface, surfaceContainer), 1 accent, no rainbow/hue-to-hue gradients. - Icons: Uniform vector/Material icons (size 20.dp/24.dp), no emoji decorations. - Copy: Calm, direct, no exclamation marks or hype words. - Typography: M3 type scale, normal/medium weights, tabular figures for metrics. - Layout & Details: Consistent corner radii (RoundedCornerShape), subtle hairlines/elevation, no glowing drop shadows. - Motion: Restrained Material transitions (tween 150-200ms).
Present the audit and refined Kotlin Compose / XML code with explanations.
